title: Command::map / Task::map for effect remapping

Added unit tests in src/command.rs covering event/effect/both mappings, batch+parallel mapping, and none mapping. Quality gate passed: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test.
close_reason: Implemented Command::map/map_event/map_effect and Task::map/map_event/map_effect. Tests passing.

title: Effect cancellation by ID
description: Cancel in-flight effects by a user-defined ID. Critical for debounce/search-as-you-type patterns. When a new effect with the same ID is dispatched, the previous one is cancelled. TCA has this built into Effect type. We need it in Task/Shell. P2 - after TestStore and Scope.
notes: Effect cancellation by ID implemented via Command::cancellable/CommandStep::CancellableEffect and Shell cancel-generation tracking. Added behavior tests and command construction tests.

title: Scope composition - fractal feature architecture
description: TCA-inspired Scope: compose child features into parents. Each feature owns its Model, Events, handlers. Parent embeds child state as a field, child actions as enum variant. Need: (1) ctx.scope() to create child EventContext from parent, (2) Command::map to remap child effects to parent, (3) action routing from parent enum variant to child dispatch. Solves the flat-model scaling disaster from Elm/Iced experience.
notes: Implemented scope composition primitives: added EventContext::scope for child model projection with independent borrow bitset and EffectContext::scope for derived child resources. Added comprehensive scope composition tests in src/extract.rs covering basic child mutation, command mapping to parent enums, independent borrow tracking, multiple child composition, EffectContext scope derivation, and TestStore integration. Quality gate passed: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test.
close_reason: Implemented EventContext::scope() and EffectContext::scope() with 6 tests. Fractal composition works.

title: TestStore - synchronous logic testing harness
description: TCA-inspired TestStore that validates the event->state->effect cycle synchronously. Send events, assert state mutations, assert emitted effects, simulate effect results by feeding events back. Must work with EventContext magic handlers. Include assert_panic helper for borrow-rule verification. P0 priority - the safety net for runtime borrow checks.nnDesign notes from oracle consultation:n- Test LOGIC only (synchronous state machine). Don't run real effects.n- Assert effect REQUESTS, not effect execution.n- Simulate effect results by manually feeding events back.n- API sketch: store.send(Ev::Inc(5)); assert_eq!(store.state().counter, 5); store.assert_effects(vec![Fx::Log(...)]); store.send(Ev::LogDone);n- Consider std::panic::catch_unwind for testing borrow-rule violations.
notes: Implemented `TestStore` synchronous harness with effect buffering/assertions and panic helpers. Added tests covering state transitions, chained events, batch/parallel effect capture, and borrow-rule panic assertions with EventContext magic handlers. Full `cargo test` passes. Full quality gate remains blocked by pre-existing repo-wide fmt/clippy failures tracked in syzygy-jad.
close_reason: Implemented and committed. TestStore with send/assert_effects/assert_panic helpers. 4 tests passing.
